name: Ensemble Interpretation

math_relation_to_SQM.equations_summary: It uses the full mathematical formalism of SQM but restricts its domain of applicability to statistical ensembles, denying its relevance to individual events.

key_claims: The quantum state (wave function) is a mathematical description of a conceptual ensemble of identically prepared systems, not a description of a single system.
Quantum probabilities are standard statistical probabilities, representing the frequency of obtaining a certain measurement result over the ensemble.
